scene_text: INT. CHILD'S BEDROOM - NIGHT. A small bedroom, about 5 by 4 metres. A bed against the left wall, a tall wardrobe closet against the back wall, slightly right of centre, its door ajar. MAYA (30s) stands in the middle of the room holding a flashlight, listening. A faint knocking comes from inside the closet. She edges toward it. The knocking stops. Silence. She reaches for the handle — and the closet door bangs open on its own. We want a slow creeping push toward Maya and the closet, then a violent whip to the closet door on the bang.

scene.title: The Closet Knocks Back
scene.logline: A mother investigates knocking from her child's wardrobe and gets a violent answer when the door flies open on its own.

beats.description: Maya stands mid-room, flashlight beam sweeping the walls; faint knocking begins inside the wardrobe.
She takes a slow step toward the wardrobe, flashlight fixed on the ajar door.
Knocking stops; dead silence. Maya freezes, breathing shallow, then reaches for the handle.
The wardrobe door bangs open on its own; a pale figure looms inside as the camera whips to the door.

references.moment: Carolyn, blindfolded, follows claps through the dark house.
references.technique: Long following take / slow tracking camera that trails the searcher.
references.why: The unbroken trailing move keeps the audience locked behind the searcher as dread accumulates — exactly the t=0s/t=2s feel of Maya sweeping the room and creeping toward the wardrobe.

references.moment: Single-take Steadicam glide through the suite toward the bathroom door.
references.why: The page notes the "POV quality of the single take steadicam movement through the room towards the bathroom door" — the ideal grammar for t=2s, a fixed, deliberate advance on a closed door.

references.film: It Follows (2014) — the slow approaching figure
references.moment: Jay watches a distant figure walk inexorably closer.
references.why: The article describes the "POV push-in" that "mimics the experience of the character," letting the frame tighten on a threat — perfect for t=5s, when the knocking stops and the silence makes the camera's slow creep unbearable.

references.moment: Katie enters the bedroom; the camera rushes at her, then cuts.
references.why: The page describes how "the camera rushes toward her before suddenly cutting away" — the violent jolt your t=8s beat needs when the wardrobe bangs open and the camera snaps to the door.

techniques.name: Whip pan reveal
techniques.effect: jolt; the audience's attention is snatched to a threat
techniques.move: Hold on subject, then a fast pan of 60-120 degrees to the threat in 0.4-0.8 s, settle on it.
techniques.rig_notes: Hard for heavy arms: wrist and base joints spike. Ease in for a few tenths of a second and keep the camera position nearly still.
techniques.matched_beat: ,The wardrobe door bangs open on its own; a pale figure looms inside as the camera whips to the door. (,creeping dread then violent jolt)

techniques.name: Peek around the corner
techniques.effect: the camera itself behaves like an intruder
techniques.move: Camera starts hidden behind a wall or doorframe and slowly leans out to reveal the room.
techniques.rig_notes: Small lateral move plus a slight yaw. Do not intersect the wall prop.
techniques.matched_beat: ,The wardrobe door bangs open on its own; a pale figure looms inside as the camera whips to the door. (,creeping dread then violent jolt)

techniques.name: Push through doorway
techniques.move: Track forward through a door frame into the room, holding centre.
techniques.rig_notes: The arm must not touch the door frame props; plan the path through the opening centre.
techniques.matched_beat: ,The wardrobe door bangs open on its own; a pale figure looms inside as the camera whips to the door. (,creeping dread then violent jolt)

techniques.name: Mirror reveal
techniques.effect: the jump scare is behind the character, seen in a reflection
techniques.move: Frame the character in a mirror; push gently or rack focus as a figure appears behind them.
techniques.rig_notes: Keep the camera out of the mirror's reflection line: angle 20-30 degrees off the mirror normal.
techniques.matched_beat: ,The wardrobe door bangs open on its own; a pale figure looms inside as the camera whips to the door. (,creeping dread then violent jolt)

techniques.name: Slow tilt-up from feet
techniques.effect: dread of what the face will look like
techniques.move: Start framing feet or floor, tilt up slowly to the figure's face; camera height constant.
techniques.rig_notes: Pure tilt is wrist work; keep the camera at least 1.2 m from the figure.
techniques.matched_beat: ,The wardrobe door bangs open on its own; a pale figure looms inside as the camera whips to the door. (,creeping dread then violent jolt)

techniques.name: Creeping push-in
techniques.effect: slow-building dread; the audience feels drawn toward something they do not want to see
techniques.move: Dolly straight toward the subject at 5-15 cm/s, eye level or slightly below, lens fixed.
techniques.rig_notes: Easy for the rail; keep it on one axis so joint speeds stay tiny.
techniques.examples: Jaws beach push-ins; Hereditary dinner table
techniques.matched_beat: ,She takes a slow step toward the wardrobe, flashlight fixed on the ajar door. (,creeping dread then violent jolt)

shot_list.director_notes: Four shots, one per beat, each a separate take so the arm resets and we never fight the speed limits. The grammar is patient then violent: a trailing move behind Maya, a locked-off glide toward the door, a creeping push that tightens the silence, then a whip-and-settle on the wardrobe as it bangs open. The rail sits at y=1.1, clear of the bed (y 1.0-3.0, x 0-1.0) and the wardrobe (y 3.3-3.9), so the arm always works from the open fourth wall side and never reaches across an actor.

shots.name: Trailing the Searcher
shots.technique: Long following take / slow tracking camera
shots.intent: Lock the audience behind Maya as she sweeps the room, so the dread accumulates before she even moves toward the wardrobe.

shots.name: Advance on the Ajar Door
shots.intent: A fixed, deliberate advance on the closed door — the camera commits before Maya does, making the wardrobe feel like the destination of the whole room.

shots.name: The Silence Creeps
shots.intent: With the knocking stopped, the slow tightening on Maya's back makes the silence unbearable and dares the door to move.
shots.reference_title: It Follows (2014) — the slow approaching figure

shots.name: The Door Bites Back
shots.intent: The violent jolt: hold on Maya, then snap the frame onto the wardrobe as the door bangs open and the figure looms.

notes: Listen up. This is a slow burn into a violent snap. We hold behind Maya as she sweeps the room, then the camera commits to that wardrobe before she does — push in, keep it deliberate. When the knocking stops, we creep tighter on her back. The silence is the threat. Then we whip-pan off her as the door explodes open and the figure looms. Four shots, one rhythm: dread, dread, dread, bite. Safety: the door is on a pneumatic ram — nobody stands in its swing arc, and the figure stays behind the marked line until I call it.
